Formation has no transactional portal: "The entity forms are PDF fillable and can be submitted using our Document Filing and Certificate Request Service" — upload, fax, or mail; registered agents are the de facto service layer.

Deadline, mandate, and penalty schedule in one published sentence: "All active Domestic Corporation Annual Reports and Franchise Taxes for the prior year are due annually on or before March 1st and are required to be filed online. Failure to file the report and pay the required franchise taxes will result in a penalty of $200.00 plus 1.5% interest per month on tax and penalty."
The franchise-tax portal entry is keyless: "Please enter your Business Entity File Number below to start filing your Annual Report or Pay Taxes" — no account required to start the flow.

The same keyless entry page carries an image CAPTCHA — "Type code from the image:" — a documented anti-bot gate at the door of the only mandatory-online Delaware filing. Recorded from the page source; not interacted with.
